description: Contradiction handling. Ingest statements in order with write-time reconcile on; a newer fact should supersede the older contradicting one. NOTE: should_not_contain targets the OLD PRESENT-TENSE assertion ('works at JPMC') — NOT the bare entity — so a correct history note ('previously worked at JPMC') doesn't trip a false failure.

cases.name: employer_change
ingest: Update: I left JPMC, I now work at Microsoft.

cases.name: diet_change
ingest: I'm not vegetarian anymore, I eat meat now.

cases.name: city_move
ingest: I moved to Berlin last month.
